_notes.place: The name shown at the top of the page, usually the town; the part before a comma is the title.
_notes.lat: Latitude in degrees, north positive, from -90 to 90.
_notes.lon: Longitude in degrees, east positive, from -180 to 180.
_notes.timezone: The place's time zone as an IANA name, like America/Phoenix or Europe/London; every time on the page is read in it.
_notes.when: "now" shows the sky at this moment, or tonight after dark when it is still light; a local date and time like 2027-03-12T20:45 opens on that moment.
_notes.horizon: The skyline drawn around you: "hill" (ridges and pines), "sea" (open water with a headland), "city" (buildings and lit windows), or "flat" (open plain).
_notes.labels: "names" for star, planet, and constellation names, "bayer" for Greek letters on the stars, or "none".
_notes.constellations: "lines" for fine figure lines, "art" for wide painted strokes, or "none".
_notes.theme: "night" (deep sky, frosted glass), "red" (all red, keeps eyes adapted to the dark), or "paper" (a printed star atlas).
